title: 多因素驗證系統
summary: 以驗證因子、抗網釣與安全復原串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect authentication factors, phishing resistance and secure recovery through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 因子分類：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Factor categories: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「因子分類」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For factor categories, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「因子分類」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：知識、持有與生物特徵代表不同因子類別。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較兩個知識因子與不同類別因子。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「因子獨立」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around factor categories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat factor independence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較兩個知識因子與不同類別因子。 比較「因子分類」與「因子獨立」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Compare whether evidence for factor categories and factor independence supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「因子分類」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for factor categories. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 知識、持有與生物特徵代表不同因子類別。
knowledge.textEn: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「因子獨立」：兩個驗證步驟未必來自獨立因子。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「因子分類」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring factor independence: Two verification steps need not represent independent factors. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove factor categories passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較兩個知識因子與不同類別因子。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設六位數等機率碼為 1000000 種，最多 5 次猜測的成功率上界 5/1000000=0.0005%；未考慮被竊取、重放或有偏分布，不能據此評估整體 MFA 安全。
knowledge.textEn: A uniform six-digit code has 1000000 values; five guesses bound success at 0.0005%, excluding theft, replay and biased generation and not measuring total MFA security.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「多因素驗證系統」的「因子分類：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Factor categories: architecture and principle” in “Multifactor authentication systems”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「因子分類」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of factor categories?
options: 知識、持有與生物特徵代表不同因子類別。
密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。
只檢查「因子獨立」，便可取代「因子分類」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories.
A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication.
Checking factor independence alone replaces verification specific to factor categories.
quiz.explanation: 知識、持有與生物特徵代表不同因子類別。 相鄰的「因子獨立」有不同責任：兩個驗證步驟未必來自獨立因子。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Neighboring factor independence has a different role: Two verification steps need not represent independent factors. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 因子分類：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Factor categories: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「因子分類」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For factor categories, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「知識、持有與生物特徵代表不同因子類別。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較兩個知識因子與不同類別因子。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「因子獨立」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from factor independence to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Compare whether evidence for factor categories and factor independence supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「因子分類」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat one-time codes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較兩個知識因子與不同類別因子。 比較「認證保證」與「一次性碼」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Compare whether evidence for authentication assurance and one-time codes supports the same inference.
